description.p: Drink Builder shows what you can mix with the bottles you have. Mark what is at hand, and the app lists the drinks you can make, the ones that need a substitute and the ones missing a single ingredient. Every drink shows its ingredients and its balance as numbers: alcohol by volume after dilution, sugar and acid.

It works offline. The recipes are built in; what you have at hand stays on your device unless the household shares a space over storage it configured itself, on GitHub or on a WebDAV server of its choice. There is no server of ours, no account and no telemetry.

ul.li: The preferences can create a space, kept in step through a GitHub repository or a WebDAV folder, and leave a space after a confirmation that says what is deleted on this device and what stays in the storage.
Report a Problem… in the main menu sends a problem or an idea as a GitHub issue, with your own token or through the filled-in issue form in the browser; About links to that form.
The app's page in the software centre shows screenshots.
The text fields of the preferences take the keyboard on a tap of a finger only, so a drag that starts on one scrolls the preferences; a mouse works as before. Not tried on a phone.

description.p: Drink Builder is now also an app for Linux phones and desktops: browse the drinks, mark your bottles and see what you can make.
